assertions: Ordinary team_orchestrate and orchestrator.run quality remains shadow-only.
Ordinary quality reports source=ordinary_orchestration_scorecard, verified=false, and routingEligible=false.
Caller-supplied qualityState is ignored and cannot change routing.
Active Routing Memo authority requires a same-session Task Loop run with bounded evidence and a matching runtime scorecard.
Cross-session, running, errored, evidence-less, and scorecard-less authority references fail closed.
Results separate current result quality authority from whether prior quality authority affected routing.
Ordinary orchestration exposes diagnostics only and does not inherit Task Loop repair, blocked, or checkpoint fields.
uiImpact: No renderer-visible interaction changed; Electron E2E was not required.

docsReview.reason: The READMEs do not document this internal quality-authority RPC boundary.
